# Television of Nomads

> > A travel blog documenting cultural experiences, destination guides, and practical advice across Asia, with deep expertise in South Korea, Japan, Southeast Asia, and beyond.

Television of Nomads shares immersive travel stories and guides from destinations including South Korea (especially Jeju Island), Japan (Kyoto), Thailand (Chiang Mai), Laos, China, Peru, and Indonesia. The site combines destination guides, cultural experiences, accommodation reviews, and travel gear recommendations for independent travelers and digital nomads.

## Key Topics

- South Korea travel (Jeju Island, Seoul)
- Japan cultural experiences (Kyoto, Tokyo)
- Southeast Asia destinations (Chiang Mai, Laos, Bali)
- Kimono and yukata rental experiences
- Korean food and cuisine
- Travel photography (Canon 80D)
- Digital nomad lifestyle
- Teaching English abroad
- Cultural activities and traditions
- Luxury and boutique hotels
- Travel gear reviews
- UNESCO World Heritage sites
- Island destinations and beaches
- Adventure travel experiences
